fields.description: Anthropic effort level. Intent classification is a simple, latency-sensitive task, so it defaults to low.
fields.label: Effort

fields.description: Leave blank to use the provider's own endpoint. Required for OpenAI-compatible, where there is no default to fall back to.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Stored encrypted and never returned to a client. Ollama needs none. For Anthropic, leaving this blank falls back to the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable.
fields.label: API Key
Budget and Rate Limits
fields.description: The server is the only place these are enforced. A limit kept in a client is a suggestion. Zero means no limit — which is the current default and is a deliberate choice, not an oversight.

fields.label: Daily Tokens per User
fields.description: Tokens are the unit that always works: any provider that reports usage gives them. 0 = unlimited.

fields.label: Daily Cost per User
fields.description: Only bites once rates are configured on AI Provider; before that every turn is priced at zero and this can never trigger. 0 = unlimited.

fields.label: Turns per Minute per User
fields.description: A burst guard, not a budget. It stops a stuck client or a loop, which is a different failure from somebody working hard all day. 0 = unlimited.
